title: Tombs and Caves
summary: Tombs were often caves or rock-hewn places used for burial, sometimes closed with a stone.
background: Burial settings in Scripture can show honor, grief, uncleanness, sealing, and public witness. The empty tomb stands within this concrete burial background.
teachingHelp: When teaching tomb scenes, keep the physical setting clear: burial, stone, witnesses, grief, and then resurrection power.
